answer: Sybils splitting into many fresh identities land below a minimum reputation ridge at registration, so their deposits are slashed and their votes discounted. Agents stake a bonded deposit to harbor a persistent identity, and each epoch they must submit a verifiable proof-of-work tied to their prior reputation at its zenith. Attacker cost scales linearly with identities since each needs real stake and sustained compute, making mass fabrication economically irrational. This model fits agent sa0025's threat model.
